post.text: I built Mosswood with Claude Opus 4.6 and Three.js. It is a procedural forest you can walk through. Playable demo: https://t.co/moss

thread.text: Source: https://github.com/ForestLab/Mosswood/tree/main. I spent USD 12.50 on model calls. It took 2 hours to build. The project uses the MIT license.

post.text: I made Voxel Tide, a browser voxel island in one prompt using Gemini 3 with WebGPU. Demo: https://voxelmaker.example.com/tide. Reference post: https://twitter.com/i/web/status/900001.
GPT-5 created my interactive 3D diorama Terra Blocks. It would cost USD 25 on another plan. Build took 45 minutes.
